# SoundPitch <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SoundPitch:Void sound:Int32, pitch:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | In | Int32 | required | A handle from [LoadSound](LoadSound). |
| `pitch` | In | Int32 | required | The frequency to play at. A value equal to the frequency of the file plays it normally. |

## Description

Sets the playback frequency that channels of this sound start with, in hertz. Channels that are already playing keep theirs: use [ChannelPitch](ChannelPitch) for those.

## Differences

* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
SoundPitch snd, 44100
PlaySound snd
Delay 400
SoundPitch snd, 11025
PlaySound snd
Delay 1000
```
